description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makuluwa, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810013
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content focuses on land adjudication and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
